title: Where the US's 165 volcanoes actually are

source.name: Alaska Volcano Observatory volcano count vs Global Volcanism Program US total

notes: USGS's Alaska Volcano Observatory catalogues over 130 volcanoes and volcanic fields active in Alaska (mostly along the Aleutian arc); the Smithsonian GVP lists 165 Holocene volcanoes for the US overall, so roughly 35 sit outside Alaska (Hawaii, Cascades, CNMI, etc.).
